subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should unattended cron jobs inherit a configured announcement recipient, and how should that interact with omitted delivery mode and multi-account channel configuration?
rationale: This changes a security-sensitive default for autonomous message delivery and introduces new core configuration, so code inspection cannot determine the intended recipient and fail-safe policy.

options.title: Add cron-scoped defaults
options.body: Add cron.defaults.delivery with job-level precedence, explicit account selection, validation, and a documented rule for omitted mode.

options.title: Extend channel defaultTo
options.body: Make the existing account delivery target apply to cron as well, accepting a broader cross-surface configuration contract.

options.title: Require per-job targets
options.body: Keep cron delivery fail-closed or silent unless each announcing job explicitly names its recipient.

recommendation.title: Add cron-scoped defaults
recommendation.body: Add cron.defaults.delivery with job-level precedence, explicit account selection, validation, and a documented rule for omitted mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The current initial-delivery policy and most subsequent cron config evolution trace to this contributor, who also supplied prior product-triage context on the issue.
